title: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont
subtitle: Modeling studies
role: Precedent modeling study, UC DAAP MLA
summary: A precedent study of Adolphe Alphand’s 1867 Parc des Buttes-Chaumont in Paris: the park’s constructed terrain around the lake and belvedere island rebuilt as physical contour models, with sections cut through the cliffs and water.

sections.heading: Study
sections.body: Reading constructed topography by building it: carved stacked-contour terrain models of the quarry landform around the lake basin and belvedere island, with cut sections — landform you have modeled by hand is landform you can shape.
